job.title: Senior AI Systems Engineer
responsibilities: Architect and scale multi-agent LLM systems with autonomous reasoning and error correction.
Design ultra-low latency RAG pipelines handling millions of vector embeddings.
Build real-time spoken and multimodal user experiences with resilient fallback strategies.
Mentor junior engineers and champion clean code, rigorous testing, and secure data handling.
technical_requirements: Demonstrated experience designing production LLM agents with state management.
Deep understanding of vector indexing algorithms (HNSW, IVFFlat) and hybrid search.
Proficiency in asynchronous Python, API rate-limiting, and error-resilient microservices.

education.minimum: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related engineering field

mandatory_requirements: Minimum 3 years of hands-on software development experience.
